title: Senior Data Scientist
text:
Senior Data Scientist

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our AI team. You will build machine learning models, design experiments, and translate data insights into business impact. This is a hands-on role requiring strong coding skills and the ability to communicate results to non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills
- 4+ years of experience in data science or machine learning
- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
- Experience with machine learning frameworks: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
- Solid understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and A/B testing
- Experience building and deploying ML models in production
- Proficiency with data manipulation using pandas and numpy
- Experience with data visualization tools (matplotlib, Plotly, or Tableau)
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Experience with Git and version control

Preferred Skills
- Experience with NLP or natural language processing
- Knowledge of deep learning and neural networks
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
- Familiarity with big data tools like Apache Spark or Airflow
- Experience with Docker and containerization
- Experience leading or mentoring junior team members
- Published research or conference presentations

Education
M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field preferred.

title: Full Stack Web Developer
text:
Full Stack Web Developer

About the Role
We are hiring a Full Stack Developer to build and maintain our customer-facing web platform. You will work across the entire stack, from React frontends to Node.js backends, and deploy on cloud infrastructure.

Required Skills
- 2+ years of professional web development experience
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
- Experience with React or React.js for frontend development
- Backend development with Node.js and Express
- Database experience with PostgreSQL or MongoDB
- Understanding of REST API design and implementation
- Experience with Git and version control
- Knowledge of HTML and CSS
- Familiarity with agile development practices

Preferred Skills
- Experience with Docker and containerization
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
- Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms
- Familiarity with Terraform or infrastructure as code
- Experience with GraphQL
- Knowledge of testing frameworks and test driven development
- Experience with Vue.js or Angular as additional frontend frameworks
